name: inflector_to_sentence_case
description: Convert to Sentence case — first letter capital, rest lowercase, words space-separated.

name: inflector_to_title_case
description: Convert to Title Case — every word capitalized, space-separated.

name: inflector_to_plural
description: Pluralize an English word — handles irregulars (person→people, mouse→mice).

name: inflector_to_singular
description: Singularize an English word. The v1.5 source fix 8628623 (extension version 2026100701) adds people → person and children → child, preserving the suffix case and compound prefixes. The DuckDB 2.0 builds in the Query.Farm repository include it; the older community build ac9b69f (DuckDB 1.5) leaves those plurals unchanged.

name: inflector_to_table_case
description: Rails-style 'table_case' — snake_case + plural. e.g. UserAccount → user_accounts.

name: inflector_humanize
description: Turn an identifier into a human-readable label, like Rails `humanize`: a trailing `_id` is dropped and the rest is rendered in Sentence case. Respects the `inflector_acronyms` setting. New in the DuckDB 2.0 build.

examples.code: SELECT inflector_humanize('author_id') AS a, inflector_humanize('employee_salary') AS b;

name: inflector_parameterize
description: Build a URL slug: accents are removed, letters are lowercased, and every run of characters that are not letters or digits becomes a single `-`, with no leading or trailing dash. Letters and digits from other scripts (for example CJK) are kept. New in the DuckDB 2.0 build.

name: inflector_classify
description: Turn a table name into a class name, like Rails `classify`: the last word is singularized and the result is rendered in PascalCase. Respects the `inflector_acronyms` setting. New in the DuckDB 2.0 build.

examples.code: SELECT inflector_classify('egg_and_hams') AS a, inflector_classify('people') AS b;

name: inflect
description: Apply a named transform (`'camel'`, `'snake'`, `'pascal'`, `'kebab'`, etc.) to one of: a string, every key in a struct, or every column name in a query result. The headline function for renaming a whole shape in one call. Pass `strip_accents := true` to the table form, or `true` as a third argument to the scalar form, to remove diacritics from the transformed names (`'CaféNoël'` → `'cafe_noel'`). In the DuckDB 2.0 build, names that collide after renaming (for example `fooBar` and `foo_bar` both becoming `foo_bar`) are made unique in column order by appending `_1`, `_2`, …, compared case-insensitively like DuckDB identifiers; earlier builds produced duplicate column names.

examples.description: Rewrite every column of a query
Colliding names get a numeric suffix (DuckDB 2.0 build)
examples.code: SELECT * FROM inflect('snake', (SELECT 1 AS fooBar, 2 AS foo_bar));
